Exactly what's showing on your phone will appear on the TV, whether it's an app, a photo, or a video.
Any action you take on your phone, like navigating to a different app, will also be shown on the TV screen.

steps: Casting is similar to screen mirroring in that you use your mobile device to control what's on your TV.
However, instead of showing the same content on both devices, your mobile device acts like a remote control.
Certain apps, like Netflix or YouTube, allow you to cast videos from your phone directly to a big screen.
Even if you don't have a Smart TV, you can use third-party casting devices like Chromecast or an Amazon Fire Stick to stream videos.
To screen cast to your Samsung TV, ensure both devices are on the same Wi-Fi network.
